flags: Order follows increasing strip miles toward Tiller, Milo and Canyonville, reversing ODOT's description and the current draft.
ODOT calls this a Tour Route. The catalog's broader State Scenic Byway label is not used as its formal designation.
The cache has no route-construction or designation history. The historical paragraph follows its bridges rather than inventing a road-building narrative.

ODOT says Horse Creek Bridge was moved in 1986; the bridge, creek and town articles describe salvaged timbers arriving in 1990 after dismantling in 1987. Omitted the disputed relocation date and distinguished reuse from moving an intact bridge.

Current Letitia Carson claim is supported only by a secondary article; its national first-71 superlative lacks authoritative supporting evidence in the cache. Omitted the claim pending stronger historical sourcing.
Red Top Pond is kept short because the cache supplies only a brief route description. Seasonal closure note is checked against the cache, not live road conditions.
ODOT gives 68 miles; material maps 65.2. Used ODOT's published route distance.
